act_title: Once, the Sacred Seat of Judgment

quests.title: Once, the Sacred Seat of Judgment

dialogue.sit: A dragon judge... Is it just me, or is that familiar somehow?

dialogue.t: "I fear you imagine quite the different beast."

dialogue.sit: Sounds like you don't like it here.

dialogue.t: "And neither would you, were you ever to have been regarded as a criminal."
"Let us go. We shall see where they have hidden the permit..."
"It seems they have left it over there... Did they even think to hide it at all?"
"Still, it seems but an empty shell..."
Hey, hey, what's with all these Rifthounds? Gah, that means the permit's...
"Gate security may have been neutralized, allowing them to take advantage of the opening and enter."
W—Wait, what do we do, then?
"No matter. We need only activate the Chamber of Deliberation's repair and purification facilities."
"They are over there..."
"I knew you would arrive, and so I prepared a welcome of suitable pomp and circumstance..."
Rawr!
"Though I know that you are only being polite, I am indeed glad to see you."
Huh, so it's you after all! So, uh, what are you calling yourself this time?
"This time, my name belonged to a scribe from the Chamber of Deliberation. In truth, he rarely ever touched quill or ink himself — not since the Secret Source Servants were invented, anyway."
"Awanyu... You may address me so."
Alright then, Awanyu. So, are you here to help us out with this "Sacred Mountain Heart Permit" thing?
"If you are without it, the Astral Assemblages within the Heart of the Sacred Mountain will attack upon detecting any unauthorized entry..."
"...I have extracted records from 'Awanyu.' According to them, the permit required to enter the Heart of the Sacred Mountain has been placed above the Chamber of Deliberation."
"For that cause, I have no choice but to set foot in this place... This congress of arrogant fools, this assembly of those who gloried in their powerlessness."
"Not to mention a den of pretenders claiming the right to judge their own kin..."
Shadow foe threat detected...
Internal safeguard... Auto-repair mode activated...
Ah! Paimon never imagined there'd be these sorts of mechanisms inside a place like this... Those monsters never stood a chance!
"This place was built to outlast the very eons themselves. Not only does it bristle with defenses, but it is even capable of self-repair..."
It's so golden and shiny... Paimon wants to touch it!
Rawr!
"Haha, it would be best not to... It will not distinguish between 'friend' or 'foe'... It simply consumes everything it touches."
"...A crass and brutal approach. Hmph, the designs these fools came up with..."
Still, we can use it to open the shield covering the permit, right?

dialogue.sit: A serious proposal — a rarity from our dear Paimon...

dialogue.t: Rawr!
Anyway... Let's find a way to make this thing ascend, shall we?
Whew, that's a wrap — finally! Guess we've got the permit to enter that "Heart of the Sacred Mountain" or whatever now!
"No. As I said before, this is merely the permit's empty shell..."
"A device made from a single scale, bereft of any information concerning its owner, cannot be converted into a permit."
"Otherwise, would it not have become some sort of master key, to be used by any old dragon?"

dialogue.sit: Quickly, bring a dragon of suitable status to the stand!

dialogue.t: Where are we supposed to find a dragon... Hey, wait! Does {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} count?
Rrrawr?
"Not... at the moment, no."
Then what do we do?
"Long ago, after the great sovereign entered the Heart of the Sacred Mountain, there were some who had the authority to, yet did not, activate this permit."
"Perhaps this conspicuous specimen was placed here for that very purpose..."
"There it is, the engraving light that can activate the scale. That is the permit..."
Rawr!
Phew, you can see the whole Sacred City from here!
"Indeed, the shadow of a glorious, unhappy past..."
Wrroh... Rawrr?
"You wish to know the final outcome of that trial? Haha..."

"Of course, those who called for sacred judgment knew that the master of all light and flame was simply feigning death, but when the true king, only occasionally clear-minded, made an appearance in the flesh..."
"The Thirteen Lords and Three Princes, who before could not stop speaking, hastily withdrew their words, and the whole trial descended into farce, and was thus dissolved..."
Rrooo...
"Later on, the Three Princes would be slain in battle against humanity, while ten of the Thirteen Lords fell when the Sacred City of Tollan collapsed, with one remaining in Chichen Uctokah..."
"But one lord survives to the present day..."
"Though doubtless not in the form that it would have wished to maintain..."
"Alright. Let us continue into the Heart of the Sacred Mountain. There, all lies buried... including a yearning for the journey's end."
"My duty shall soon be discharged in full... Chosen of Dragons, if only you could have seen this place in its fullest splendor, its truest beauty..."
"Go, touch the flame-engraved light... Win permission to reach the Sacred Mountain's heart..."
Awanyu... Huh, gone again! Paimon was just getting used to using that name.
Still, the permit to enter the Heart of the Sacred Mountain is ours at last...
Rrroar...
The light on this side... It's gone...

quests.description: In order to uncover a path to the Heart of the Sacred Mountain, it appears you must obtain a permit from the Chamber of Deliberation…
